name: ConvertorApp
description: Tired of juggling tabs just to convert a JSON or fix a messy query? 😩 Same here. So I built the Multi Converter Tool—a lightweight, browser-based toolbox for devs and QA who want everything (XML, JSON, HEX, and more) in one tidy place. One tool. Zero tab chaos. Maximum sanity.  🙌

paragraphs: A comprehensive and user-friendly web-based utility suite designed for developers, testers, and data analysts. This all-in-one conversion toolkit provides essential data transformation and formatting capabilities in a clean, organized interface.
features: Epoch Time Converter - Bidirectional epoch/timestamp conversion with timezone support
Text Format Converter - Hex, Binary, Base64, URL encoding/decoding
Color Converter - Hex, RGB, HSL color conversions with live preview
JSON/XML Converter - Format validation, conversion, and beautification
